source: Dallas City Code ch. 51P, Article 128 (City Attorney's codified article, April 2026)

sections.title: Legislative History
sections.text: SEC. 51P-128.101.LEGISLATIVE HISTORY. PD 128 was established by Ordinance No. 17123, passed by the Dallas City Council on September 16, 1981. Ordinance No. 17123 amended Ordinance No. 10962, Chapter 51 of the Dallas City Code, as amended. Ordinance No. 17123 was amended by Ordinance No. 17858, passed by the Dallas City Council on May 25, 1983, and Ordinance No. 23169, passed by the Dallas City Council on June 11, 1997. (Ord. Nos. 10962; 17123; 17858; 23169; 25508)

sections.title: Property Location And Size
sections.text: SEC. 51P-128.102.PROPERTY LOCATION AND SIZE. PD 128 is established on property fronting on the west line of Hampton Road, approximately 285.8feet south of the south line of Glenfield Avenue. The size of PD 128 is approximately 18 acres. (Ord. Nos. 17123; 25508)

sections.title: Definitions And Interpretations
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-128.103.DEFINITIONS AND INTERPRETATIONS.
(a)Unless otherwise stated, the definitions and interpretations in Chapter 51 apply to this article.
(b)Unless otherwise stated, all references to articles, divisions, or sections in this article are to articles, divisions, or sections in Chapter 51. (Ord. 25508)

sections.title: Conceptual Plan
sections.text: SEC. 51P-128.104.CONCEPTUAL PLAN. Use of the Property must comply with the conceptual plan (Exhibit 128A). In the event of a conflict between the provisions of this article and the conceptual plan, the provisions of this article control. (Ord. Nos. 23169; 25508; 26232)

sections.title: Development Plan
sections.text: SEC. 51P-128.105.DEVELOPMENT PLAN. Development and use of the Property must comply with the development plan (Exhibit 128B). In the event of a conflict between the text of this article and the development plan, the text of this article controls. (Ord. Nos. 17858; 23169; 25508; 26232)

sections.title: Uses Permitted
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-128.106.USES PERMITTED.
(a)Uses within Tract 1 are limited to 0.8 acres of landscaped open space and surface parking.
(b)Uses within Tract 2 are limited to 1.2 acres of landscaped open space and surface parking.
(c)Uses within Tract 3 are limited to medical offices having a maximum area of 75,000 square feet of floor area limited to three floors, a maximum site coverage of 50 percent, and a maximum height of 38 feet.
(d)Uses within Tract 4 are limited to a hospital, medical education facilities, existing mechanical plant, office, and medical clinic or ambulatory surgical center with a maximum of 360,000 square feet of floor area limited to six floors, a maximum of 300 beds, a maximum height of 80 feet, and a maximum site coverage of 80 percent.
(e)Uses within Tract 5 are limited to 3.4 acres of parking and open space, and warehouse uses with a maximum of 4,000 square feet of floor area limited to one floor.
(f)Uses within Tract 6 are limited to four acres of parking, landscaped open space, and office, education facilities, and community meeting rooms with a maximum of 7,500 square feet of floor area limited to one floor, and a maximum height of 30 feet. (Ord. Nos. 23169; 25508; 26232)

sections.title: Platting
sections.text: SEC. 51P-128.108.PLATTING. Prior to the issuance of a building permit, a subdivision plat must be approved by the city plan commission and filed for record with the county clerk’s office. (Ord. Nos. 17858; 25508)

sections.title: Screening
sections.text: SEC. 51P-128.109.SCREENING. Screening, consisting of a six-foot solid fence, must be provided along the northern boundary of this PD. In the event Tracts 1 and 2 are used for parking, the parking areas must be screened from Hampton Road by a minimum four-foot-high berm with landscape material on top of the berm. The location of the berms and the type of plant material must be delineated on the detailed development plan at the time of submission of city plan commission approval for the parking areas in Tracts 1 and 2. (Ord. Nos. 17858; 25508)

sections.title: Fire Department Requirements
sections.text: SEC. 51P-128.110.FIRE DEPARTMENT REQUIREMENTS. Buildings must be constructed with a 100 percent automatic sprinkler system and/or fire lanes must be provided in accordance with the requirements of the fire department. (Ord. Nos. 17858; 25508)

sections.title: Drainage And Utility Requirements
sections.text: SEC. 51P-128.111.DRAINAGE AND UTILITY REQUIREMENTS. Drainage and utility requirements must comply with the requirements of the department of public works and transportation. (Ord. Nos. 17858; 25508)

sections.title: Landscaping
sections.text: SEC. 51P-128.112.LANDSCAPING. Landscaping must be provided as shown on the approved development plans. Additional landscaping may be provided as the developer desires except in Tract 6, where landscaping must be provided and completed in accordance with Article X. (Ord. Nos. 23169; 25508)

sections.title: Lighting
sections.text: SEC. 51P-128.113.LIGHTING. Light poles or standards located in parking areas may not exceed eight feet in height and must be covered to deflect light downward and away from any residentially zoned property. (Ord. Nos. 17858; 25508)

sections.title: Ingress And Egress
sections.text: SEC. 51P-128.114.INGRESS AND EGRESS. All ingress and egress must comply with the requirements of the department of public works and transportation. (Ord. Nos. 17858; 25508)

sections.title: Signs
sections.text: SEC. 51P-128.115.SIGNS. All signs on every tract must comply with the provisions for non-business districts contained in Division 51-7.400. (Ord. Nos. 17858; 25508)

sections.title: General Requirements
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-128.116.GENERAL REQUIREMENTS.
(a)Development within this PD must be in compliance with all applicable codes and regulations of the city.
(b)All paved areas, permanent drives, streets, and drainage structures, if any, must be constructed in accordance with standard city specifications, and completed to the satisfaction of the director of public works and transportation.
(c)The building official shall not issue a building permit or certificate of occupancy until there has been full compliance with this article, the Dallas Development Code, the construction codes, and all other applicable ordinances, rules, and regulations of the city. (Ord. Nos. 17858; 23169; 25508; 26102)

sections.title: Zoning Map
sections.text: SEC. 51P-128.117.ZONING MAP. PD 128 is located on Zoning Map No. M-6. (Ord. Nos. 17123; 25508)
